This file exists to be rejected, and for a different reason than the file beside
it. The script it names is real and present. What is missing is the other half
of the link: `scripts/segment.py` does not mention this lesson anywhere.

That is the shape of a pointer that rots. The script is what somebody edits in a
month. If the script does not name the reasoning, the reasoning survives only in
a file nobody has a reason to open.
